entities.summary: Bruno Ateba Edo S.A.C. is a Cameroonian Catholic prelate who serves as the bishop of the Diocese of Maroua-Mokolo, in Cameroon since 5 April 2015. Before that, he served as a priest for the Pallottines, a Catholic religious order, from 8 July 1995 until 5 April 2014. He was appointed bishop by Pope Francis. He was consecrated on 27 May 2014 by Piero Pioppo, Titular Archbishop of Torcello. He is a professed member of the Society of the Catholic Apostolate religious order.
